test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2500 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2500

Rate of Interest (R) = 9% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{2500 times 9 times 3}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{67500}{100}

⇒ SI = 675

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
